items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: we'd back up Hazel Scott or we'd back up singers like Lena Horne

ctx.x: But Joe was a great trumpet player, too. Joe did some time with me during the Second World War, and then when Joe left, I forget why -- but I was fortunate enough to get Emmett Berry on trumpet. And he's a swinging trumpet player. And I think that was the band, when I left, I let the band go, and Barney Josephson started getting on me because I didn't rehearse the band. We were a jazz band, but he felt he wasn't getting his money's worth unless we rehearsed, and we were playing for him from eight o'clock at night…
But Josephs didn't feel like he was getting his money's worth -- because we worked eight hours a night, plus we come in there after hours to rehearse. But I just refused to do it, see.
